name: "Joyous Summer" Summer Fan Art Contest
description: Dear Travelers, The "Joyous Summer" Summer Fan Art Contest has officially begun! Submitting works related to the Genshin Impact Summer theme will not only give you a chance to win rewards, but outstanding works will also have a chance to be showcased live at the Genshin Impact Summer Festival offline event. Let's enjoy a summer filled with creativity and artistry! Head to the Genshin Impact Summer Festival pre-registration page for more offline event details: https://hoyo.link/71wEDEAd
